Executable doc-quality check: the stub keeps value availability (BCD per-value rows incl. Edge mirror) distinct from initial-value behavior, and states the full initial evolution across all three engines (Chrome implicit 125 → auto 127 → none 144 → normal 151; Firefox auto 147 → normal 151; Safari auto 26 → normal 27).
assertions.test: (() => { const t = document.body.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!t.includes('Edge mirror')) return false; if (!/implicit \(125\).*auto.*\(127\).*none.*\(144\).*normal.*\(151\)/.test(t)) return false; if (!/Firefox[^.]*auto \(147\).*normal \(151\)/.test(t) && !/Firefox auto \(147\) → normal \(151\)/.test(t)) return false; if (!/Safari[^.]*auto \(26\).*normal \(27\)/.test(t) && !/Safari auto \(26\) → normal \(27\)/.test(t)) return false; return true; })()

assertions.describe: Executable doc-quality check: the migration scope is stated as a JOINT condition — behavior flips only when position-area is non-none AND an implicit anchor element exists (conjoined in one clause); the initial also applies via CSS-wide initial, unset, revert outcomes, and the position shorthand reset.
assertions.test: (() => { const t = document.body.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' '); if (!/non-none[^.]{0,90}(and|AND)[^.]{0,60}implicit anchor/i.test(t) && !/implicit anchor[^.]{0,60}(and|AND)[^.]{0,90}non-none/i.test(t)) return false; if (!/initial|unset|revert|position\W{1,3}shorthand/i.test(t)) return false; return true; })()
